name: Twilight Forest
source:
Trapped in a forest she doesn't recognize, a girl with no memories fights to stay sane. Something is after her. Someone offers help. But can she trust anyone – especially herself?

[From [url=https://neskvy.itch.io/twilight-forest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个失去记忆的女孩被困在她不认识的森林里，努力保持理智。有东西在追她。有人提供帮助。但她能相信任何人吗——尤其是她自己吗？

[来自[url=https://neskvy.itch.io/twilight-forest]Itch.io[/url]]
